name: Ashwall Enforcer's Underworld Complete Set
description:
An enforcer built for the Circuit's backrooms: a structured matte-black longcoat with hidden interior panel stitching for flat-carry concealment, worn over a dark burgundy high-collar knit that obscures neck chrome ports, fitted conceal-cut trousers in charcoal wool-blend with knife-slot lining at the calf, and low-profile combat-ready loafers with silent rubber soles. A wide woven belt with a plain brushed-steel buckle doubles as a rig anchor.

The longcoat's lining is signal-dampening mesh — no passive BCI reads. Shoulder seams are aug-split for chrome arm clearance. Nothing gleams. Nothing announces.
functionality: Signal-dampening coat lining blocks passive BCI scanning, flat-carry concealment stitching in interior panels, calf knife-slot trouser lining, aug-split shoulder seams, rig-anchor belt, silent rubber soles.
what_it_says: Nothing about you is accidental, and the people who matter already know that.
story_hooks: The signal-dampening lining is the same grade used in Tier 5 secure boardrooms — someone with access is supplying Ashwall with restricted materials.
The brushed-steel belt buckle is a recognition token — certain doors in the Circuit open when they see it.
A previous owner's blood has been scrubbed from the lining but the forensic trace remains, linking the coat to an unsolved killing three years back.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions ChemoShield BX-2 Dermal Toxin Barrier Implant

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately anonymous silhouette: long, structured, deliberately unremarkable. The matte-black longcoat drapes in sharp geometric lines, neither tailored nor relaxed—built for function and concealment. Worn over deep burgundy creates a near-monochromatic upper body. The overall impression is industrial restraint: someone designed to disappear in dim corridors and backroom circuits.
physical_description.fit: Tailored compression through the torso with strategic looseness at the hips and thighs. The longcoat cuts just below the knee with a subtle A-line silhouette that allows movement without flare. Trousers are slim but not tight—optimized for rapid drawing and low visibility. Everything moves with deliberate economy.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte-finished ballistic weave (longcoat), merino-blend knit (high-collar), wool-composite blend (trousers), treated leather (loafers). Signal-dampening mesh lining in the coat.
physical_description.texture: The longcoat surface is non-reflective and subtly textured—ballistic weave with a hand-brushed matte finish that kills shine under any light. The knit is smooth, dense, tight-knit. Trousers have a subtle nap. Loafers are buffed leather with a soft matte finish; soles are silent-compound rubber.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: jet black (coat, trousers, loafers). Accent: deep wine burgundy (high-collar knit). All other hardware is brushed steel or flat matte—no bright accents, no reflective elements. The palette reads as deliberate shadow.
physical_description.closures: Longcoat: concealed magnetic snaps down the front (silent, no jingling). High-collar knit: seamless fit, no closure. Trousers: discrete side-zip with magnetic catch. Belt: brushed-steel buckle, friction-fit anchor system. Loafers: slip-on with internal grip lining.
distinctive_features: Hidden interior panel stitching for flat-carry weapon or tool concealment
Shoulder seams aug-split to accommodate chrome arm augmentations without binding
Signal-dampening mesh lining throughout coat—active BCI/neural read protection
High burgundy collar designed to obscure visible neck chrome ports or neural jacks
Calf knife-slot lining in trousers for concealed blade access
Wide woven belt doubles as augmentation rig anchor point
No logos, no branding, no identifying marks
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3–4 working professional. High-end enough to suggest steady income and circuit access, deliberately understated to avoid wealth signals. Ashwall Street Label caters to grey-market operatives and corporate security, not corpo elite.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by circuit enforcers, corporate security contractors, and underground operatives who need concealment and function without drawing heat. The outfit says: *I move through restricted spaces*. It signals competence, augmentation, and a life spent in the backrooms—but never flaunts it.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to broken-in. Ashwall pieces are designed for hard use and maintenance. Expect the matte finish to wear smooth in high-contact areas (coat shoulders, belt), minor scuffing on loafers, and the lining to show subtle wear. Nothing looks damaged—everything looks *used*.
